_meta.status: RESEARCH_ONLY — NO HUMAN APPROVAL — NO PRODUCTION

standard_hourly_cleaner_rate.description: Hourly rate per cleaner (not per team) — residential ponctuel market
standard_hourly_cleaner_rate.note_on_60dh: Adom.ma states Casablanca tarif moyen = 60 DH/h for verified providers. National average ~50 DH/h.
standard_hourly_cleaner_rate.minimum_duration: 3–4 hours per visit (market norm for professional interventions)

worker_count_semantics.residential_standard: Typically 1 cleaner for standard residential (studio to F3). 2 cleaners for large properties or time-constrained deep cleans.
worker_count_semantics.professional_post_construction: Teams of 2–4 depending on project size.
worker_count_semantics.critical_ambiguity_detected: Some providers quote '150 MAD/h' without stating per-cleaner vs per-team. FIXEO must clarify this for artisan onboarding.
worker_count_semantics.recommended_fixeo_unit: PER_CLEANER_HOUR — artisan invoices for each cleaner present

standard_cleaning_by_property_type.description: Standard ponctuel residential cleaning — surface cleaned, standard soiling, single cleaner

daily_format_pricing.note: Daily format commonly used for weekly recurring residential cleaning. Consistent cleaner knows property.

deep_cleaning_grand_menage.description: Grand ménage complet, nettoyage en profondeur — includes vitres, placards, murs, dégraissage, désinfection

market_range_mad.note: Rabat provider quotes 700–1500 MAD for deep clean by property size

post_construction_cleaning.description: Nettoyage après travaux — construction dust, paint/cement residue, specialist equipment required

market_range_per_m2.note: nettoyage-casablanca.com: ≈12 MAD/m² for simple. casablanca-nettoyage.com: 12–25 MAD/m²

move_in_move_out_cleaning.description: Nettoyage avant/après déménagement — logement vide, remise en état, état des lieux
move_in_move_out_cleaning.pricing_model: Typically forfait or deep-clean pricing applied to empty property
move_in_move_out_cleaning.market_notes: Products and equipment always supplied by provider for this service type. Includes vitres, placards, cuisine, SDB.
move_in_move_out_cleaning.market_range_mad: See deep_cleaning + 10–20% for empty-property access premium

upholstery_sofa_cleaning.note_on_bait_price: experts-doulle-clean.ma quotes canapé from 300 MAD as 'à partir de'. Final may exceed for large/soiled items.

residential_standard.note: Highly variable by number of windows, access, height. Commercial facades = devis.

window_cleaning.standalone_service: Yes — residential window cleaning is offered as standalone by major providers
window_cleaning.specialist_boundary: Access requiring nacelle/rope = SPECIALIST or QUOTE_REQUIRED

materials_equipment_policy_findings.professional_provider_model: Major providers (O2 Maroc, NettoyageMaroc, Nettoyage-Rabat) supply ALL equipment and products for post-construction and deep-clean services.

standard_residential_ménage.common_practice: Products (cleaning agents, liquids) often supplied by CLIENT. Basic equipment (mop, bucket) varies.
standard_residential_ménage.o2_maroc_explicit: Les produits ménagers et le matériel (balai, aspirateur, serpillière) sont généralement à fournir par le client, sauf formule (premium packages supply equipment).
standard_residential_ménage.implication_for_fixeo: FIXEO must define whether the standard ménage includes or excludes client-supplied products. This is a KEY consumer clarity issue.

materials_equipment_policy_findings.upholstery_post_construction_equipment: Always provider-supplied (injection-extraction machines, industrial vacuums, steam cleaners)
materials_equipment_policy_findings.consumables_for_standard_ménage: CLIENT_SUPPLIED or ARTISAN_SUPPLIED depending on service tier — must be defined per service

minimum_booking_findings.informal_freelance_minimum: Variable — some accept 2h but 3h more common
minimum_booking_findings.travel_fee: Major providers include déplacement. Informal workers may request transport fee.
minimum_booking_findings.note: No fixed minimum found equivalent to Bricolage — but 3h minimum duration is market norm

recurring_service_findings.discount_evidence: Recurring (hebdomadaire, mensuel) bénéficient of tarif préférentiel — consistent across providers
recurring_service_findings.monthly_salary_model: Direct employment model: 2500–4500 MAD/month full-time Casablanca
recurring_service_findings.fixeo_relevance: Contract/employment model is outside FIXEO estimator scope. Recurring discount = modifier null in this phase.

soiling_complexity_levels.MODERATE: Not maintained for several weeks, moderate grease/dust
soiling_complexity_levels.HEAVY: Post-event, neglected, visible grease buildup, pet hair
soiling_complexity_levels.EXTREME: Long vacant, post-construction dust, severe grease, nicotine
soiling_complexity_levels.price_escalation_factor: Heavy vs Normal: 1.5x–2x. Extreme without construction: 2x–3x.
